About.title: About PostWizard
About.subtitle: A personal learning project by an aspiring AI product manager, helping non-native English speakers with international postcard exchanges.
About.motivationContent1: As a developer transitioning into AI product management, I wanted to learn the full-cycle AI product development through a real project. Postcard writing combines AI text generation with real social scenarios — a perfect fit.
About.motivationContent2: The goal is to help non-native English speakers write personalized, thoughtful replies to postcrossing recipients worldwide. AI isn't here to replace human expression — it's here to help people express themselves better.
About.ossDesc: PostWizard Lite is an open-source learning project. You can deploy it on your own server.
About.ossItem1: Self-hosted: Built on Next.js, runs on any Node.js environment
About.ossItem2: AI Models: Supports Qwen, Gemini, OpenAI and more — bring your own API keys
About.ossItem3: Your Data: All data stays in your local database (SQLite / PostgreSQL), never touches third parties
About.contactDesc: If you're interested in AI products or have suggestions, feel free to open an issue on GitHub.
